- **Changelog.** If a user can see this change, add a bullet to the `Unreleased` entry of `docs/changelog.mdx` (start one if the newest entry already carries a release tag) that ends with `Contributed by [@your-handle](https://github.com/your-handle).`, or write "needs a bullet" in the description. If they can't, write "not user-visible" there ([documentation](https://github.com/jannskiee/floe/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#documentation-only-needed-if-youre-changing-docs)).
